title: The Plant Labels
text: Mia helped her class make labels for the garden. Before lunch, she set the labels on a shelf by the classroom door. After lunch, she came back with Ben. They took the labels outside and placed them beside the plants.
source: Original demonstration passage from BasaBridge Grade 3 English Reading Resources
